headline: Review of FY27 grants, including eleven "maybe" votes, and proposed 2027 meeting dates.
summary: The council will keep reviewing FY27 grants and begin sorting eleven "maybe" votes into a category. Members will also review a proposed 2027 calendar with meetings on the second Monday of most months.
